notes: Pupate (PUPATE), Ethereum mainnet. This manifest deploys PupateToken and PupateHook only; supply and allocation are set by the separate launch policy. TOKEN: zero-argument constructor; 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals minted once to its deployer. Plain ERC-20 with no owner, mint, pause, fee, transfer limit or blacklist; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. The policy seeds 85% into the pool. HOOK: constructor ($poolManager, sink, owner). Sink: Cocoon at 0x54993066369e57a49215f6fc2d9911a8e5a57a79. Owner: the specified OpenZeppelin TimelockController with a 48-hour delay at 0x8be826082c0fbaec485048aa26ef42ac147898ec. These are the predeployed contracts named in the brief. Permissions match getHookPermissions: afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta. The constructor validates flags 0x18CC against its own address; deployment requires a mined CREATE2 salt. Enabled callbacks accept only the PoolManager. TAX: the first native-ETH pool initialized on the hook becomes its permanent launch pool. Tax applies to the ETH side of its swaps, except swaps whose sender is the sink. Sells start at the standing 6%; buys start at 99%, decaying one percentage point per minute to 6% after 93 minutes. The owner can only lower the standing tax and transfer ownership. Swap callbacks call only the PoolManager and collect ERC-6909 claims without moving ETH. A taxed swap naming its ETH amount reverts PartialFill if it cannot fill in full. Permissionless flush() redeems claims and sends the hook's whole ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. LIQUIDITY: additions are admitted only to the launch pool during its initialization transaction, marked with EIP-1153; deploy, initialize and seed together. Every later transaction is refused, even in the same block. Removals and fee collection are ungated. Accepted residual: the opening mark names no account, so code gaining control later in that transaction could add too; the described factory calls only the PoolManager, token and its registry there. POOL: native ETH/PUPATE, fee 12500 (1.25%), spacing 60. initialPrice remains 792281625142643375935439503360000, tick 184216, the policy's 10 ETH supply valuation. The token-only seed spans [-887220,184200]. CONTEXT: Cocoon, FloorFeed and PupateVesting are reviewed source, not deployed by this manifest. PostLaunch.s.sol wires the vault, vests the launch wallet's 5% over 12 months, pins the oracle question and transfers Cocoon and FloorFeed to the timelock. Prior vault fixes and accepted limitations are recorded in docs/REVIEW.md, including the lower purchase-price bound on actual spend and burn-limit rounding. REVIEW: both imported info findings reproduced using unchanged source and the launch parameters in test/scratch/ImportedFindings.scratch.t.sol. A later hookless ETH/PUPATE pool accepts liquidity and a 1 ETH buy with zero hook claims or totalTax (3df3451d). A 1-wei sell while the launch pool holds no ETH returns (0,0), costs no tokens and parks price at MAX_SQRT_PRICE-1; Cocoon.burn() reverts NothingBought, then a 1 ETH buy restores the range and burn succeeds (abeff3fe). Both are accepted design limitations; neither requires a source change. No additional defect identified in this review. Scratch evidence is local only. CHECKS: forge build passed with warnings; the existing forge test suite passed 227, failed 0, skipped 10 fork tests because MAINNET_RPC_URL was unset. Both additional scratch reproductions passed. Mainnet state and the real-factory fork rehearsal were not verified in this run. No audit or security claim is made.
